elements.title: Two-Stage Split Learning Strategy

figure.caption: Layer-wise knowledge distillation between teacher and student models

bullets: Offline distillation aligns FHE-friendly blocks with the original foundation model
Online adaptation enables private local training via block-by-block encrypted inference
Secure aggregation via MPC combines client updates without exposing local parameters

builds.audio_segment: BlindFed uses a two-stage strategy to bridge the gap between models.
First, offline distillation aligns the FHE-friendly student with the original teacher using auxiliary data.
Then, online adaptation uses block-by-block encrypted inference for private local training.
Finally, secure multi-party computation aggregates updates into a global model without exposing individual parameters.
